about: Sizes and usage rules for every composed material. Colors, fonts, logo and footer come from the project brand at build time (scripts/brand.py via style_tokens.tokens()); fonts are never named here (no project font: brand.py's bundled fallback). fallback_colors are brand.py's neutral defaults, used when a project has no brand colors; STYLE_DRIFT checks that they match brand.py and the sibling themes (document-builder, slide-deck) by role.
alert_use: missed goal, unfavorable change, failed save or warning only
